name: @meclis/cli
description: Install meclis advisors with one command. Browse the agora at https://meclis.chele.bi.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/index.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='dist/index.js';const b=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(!b.startsWith('#!'))fs.writeFileSync(p,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+b);fs.chmodSync(p,0o755)"
